entities.summary: Antoine Bibeau is a Canadian professional ice hockey goaltender for EHC Red Bull München of the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). Bibeau was selected by the Toronto Maple Leafs in the sixth round, 172nd overall, of the 2013 NHL entry draft.
